code_quality.notes: Files well within size budgets (largest is deflate_test.go at 340 LOC, deflate.go at 360 LOC). Code is a clean parallel of gzip.go shape — agents can read either to learn the pattern. Comments are informational and load-bearing (RFC numbers, header byte explanations, naming caveats). Two minor nits: (1) helper readBounded shared between inflate variants could similarly be shared with gzip's gunzipBounded but is intentionally not coupled per gzip.go's prior precedent; (2) zlib error message hint 'try _deflate_inflate' uses internal builtin name in user-facing text — the public API name 'inflate' would read better, deduct 2 pts.
